svg.title: Frimpong Opoku Agyemang: Engineer first. AI is the multiplier.

g.text: Engineer first. AI is the multiplier.
I've shipped Swift, React Native, TypeScript, Python and PHP since 2017, so I
know how these systems work and where they break. That's why AI makes me faster:
I design the system, direct the agents, catch what they get wrong and fix it
